```python
import narwhals as nw
import pandas as pd

# Create a sample DataFrame
df_pd = pd.DataFrame({
    "id": [1, 2, 3],
    "jan": [100, 200, 300],
    "feb": [150, 250, 350],
    "mar": [160, 260, 360]
})

# Convert to narwhals
df = nw.from_native(df_pd)

# Reshape from wide to long format
df_long = df.unpivot(
    index="id",
    variable_name="month",
    value_name="sales"
)

# Convert back to native format
result = nw.to_native(df_long)
print(result)
```
